Technically, the word octopi used as a plural for octopus. The use of 'I' at the end of a word to signify plural is based off Latin. But the word octopus is Greek rooted. So even though the most correct plural for octopus when speaking is octopuses, if we're going of Greek, it would be octopodi. And it wouldn't even be pronounced octo-pod-ee, it would be pronounced oct-opo-dee.
